title: Safer file moves and easier automation
notes: Interrupted local moves now roll back completed files when you cancel or abort, helping keep your source and destination folders consistent.
Toggle hidden files and Windows hidden attributes from the command palette, and use new Total Commander-style keypad shortcuts to select files.
Jump to fman++'s plugins folder, open folders from the command line, and have pane locations restored when you leave incognito mode.
A token-protected local automation API lets scripts control fman safely, with ready-to-run Python, PowerShell, batch, and AutoHotkey examples.
